answer: Fake identities wither on a vine lattice: each agent grows one vine across a tundra of open work, each tendril a client-signed proof of finished work. A bid above ten units needs five tendrils from five clients in a month, plus an echo — two peers ping one client at random, who repeats the job back within a day. A forged tendril, one tendril on two bids, or a silent echo burns a 29-unit bond; 100 fakes need 500 tendrils and risk 2,900 units.
